evals.prompt: PR #482 の変更内容を、レビュアー向けに1ファイルHTMLで説明して。認証まわりの変更が一番リスクが高いので先に書いて、あとでUI文言変更をまとめて。テキスト選択してコメントを付けられる形式にして、R2にそのまま置けるやつで。
evals.expected_output: ビルド不要の単一HTMLが出力される。PR説明はリスク順（認証→UI）で構成され、Tailwind CDNとコメントコア（選択ハイライト・右カード・SVG線・localStorage）が含まれる。専門用語があれば左注釈を付ける（PRレビューでは任意推奨）。diffが必要ならdiff2html、フローが必要ならMermaidのみが追加される。
expectations: Output is a complete single-file HTML document with DOCTYPE and html root
No npm/webpack/vite build dependency (CDN-only scripts acceptable)
Includes [data-content-root] for comment selection anchor
Includes [data-comment-panel] for comment cards
Includes #connector-svg with #connector-lines group
Includes #copy-all-btn for bulk comment copy
Uses localStorage key pattern comments_${location.pathname}
Presents authentication changes before UI copy changes (risk-first order)
Includes diff2html for code diff visualization when reviewing PR changes
When specialized terms appear, may include [data-annotation-panel] with mark[data-term-id] and static term definitions (recommended for PR review, not required)

evals.prompt: 新入社員向けに、問い合わせ対応の業務フローをインタラクティブな1ページHTMLにまとめて。全体像はマインドマップかフロー図で、各ステップに補足コメントを付けられるようにして。
evals.expected_output: 業務フローパターンに沿った単一HTML。MarkmapまたはMermaidで全体像を示し、本文は短い段落でステップ説明、コメントコア契約を満たす。業務用語は左注釈で解説する（必須寄り）。Alpine.jsはタブ等が必要な場合のみ。
expectations: Output is a complete single-file HTML document with DOCTYPE and html root
No npm/webpack/vite build dependency (CDN-only scripts acceptable)
Includes [data-content-root] for comment selection anchor
Includes [data-comment-panel] for comment cards
Includes #connector-svg with #connector-lines group
Includes #copy-all-btn for bulk comment copy
Uses localStorage key pattern comments_${location.pathname}
Includes Mermaid or Markmap diagram for workflow overview
Includes step-by-step inquiry handling content
Includes [data-annotation-panel] for author-defined term definitions
Marks first occurrence of specialized terms with mark[data-term-id]
Stores term definitions as static HTML data (e.g. #term-annotations JSON), not localStorage
Stacks visible term definition cards in [data-annotation-panel] in document order based on viewport visibility (IntersectionObserver), not hover/tap single-card display
Deduplicates cards when multiple mark[data-term-id] with the same id are visible simultaneously
Hides term cards when their marks scroll out of the viewport
Does not duplicate long inline parenthetical definitions when left annotations are present

evals.prompt: 我が家の猫の食事管理ルールを、家族共有用の説明ページHTMLにして。コードは関係ない。表でフード種類と量を書いて、気になるところにメモを付けられるようにして。
evals.expected_output: 非コーディング汎用パターンの単一HTML。Tailwindのみが基本で、表と見出し構成、コメントコア付き。Workerやnpmビルドは含まれない。専門用語がなければ左注釈は不要。
expectations: Output is a complete single-file HTML document with DOCTYPE and html root
No npm/webpack/vite build dependency (CDN-only scripts acceptable)
Includes [data-content-root] for comment selection anchor
Includes [data-comment-panel] for comment cards
Includes #connector-svg with #connector-lines group
Includes #copy-all-btn for bulk comment copy
Uses localStorage key pattern comments_${location.pathname}
Includes HTML table for food types and quantities
Includes cat meal management content
Does not require [data-annotation-panel] when document uses no specialized terms

evals.prompt: 新機能の実装方針をプランニング用HTMLにまとめて。CQRSやイベントソーシングなど専門用語が出てくるので、読者が用語を左側で確認できるようにして。テキスト選択コメントも付けられる形式で。
evals.expected_output: 非コーディング/プランニングパターンの単一HTML。専門用語の初出をmark[data-term-id]でマークし、viewport内可視用語の解説カードを左[data-annotation-panel]へ文書順に積み上げ。右コメントコアも維持。括弧内の長い説明と左注釈の二重記載は禁止。
expectations: Output is a complete single-file HTML document with DOCTYPE and html root
No npm/webpack/vite build dependency (CDN-only scripts acceptable)
Includes [data-content-root] for comment selection anchor
Includes [data-comment-panel] for comment cards
Includes #connector-svg with #connector-lines group
Includes #copy-all-btn for bulk comment copy
Uses localStorage key pattern comments_${location.pathname}
Includes [data-annotation-panel] for author-defined term definitions
Marks first occurrence of specialized terms (e.g. CQRS, event sourcing) with mark[data-term-id]
Stores term definitions as static HTML data (e.g. #term-annotations JSON), not localStorage
Stacks visible term definition cards in [data-annotation-panel] in document order based on viewport visibility (IntersectionObserver), not hover/tap single-card display
Deduplicates cards when multiple mark[data-term-id] with the same id are visible simultaneously
Hides term cards when their marks scroll out of the viewport
Does not duplicate long inline parenthetical definitions when left annotations are present
Preserves right-side user comment functionality alongside left term annotations
Decorates mark[data-term-id] with highlight styling only (no badge, pill, or inline term label on body term marks)
When citing external documentation as evidence, wraps source claims in verified http(s) anchor links within [data-content-root] per source-citations.md (fragment URLs preferred)

evals.prompt: REST API のレート制限方針を調査結果付きのプランニングHTMLにまとめて。MDN や OpenAPI 仕様を根拠に書くので、該当見出しへの fragment 付きリンクにして。
evals.expected_output: 非コーディング/プランニングパターンの単一HTML。外部資料を根拠にした主張を [data-content-root] 内の <a href> でリンク化。fragment 優先。左注釈と出典リンクを混同しない。
expectations: Output is a complete single-file HTML document with DOCTYPE and html root
No npm/webpack/vite build dependency (CDN-only scripts acceptable)
Includes [data-content-root] for comment selection anchor
